title: o7.b1.evaluator-implementation-manifest/v0 (schema revision 2)
description: Fail-closed closure manifest of the standalone evaluator implementation. VALIDATION revision (Finding 5): relative_path is constrained to a repository-relative, normalized, traversal-free form. JSON Schema draft 2020-12 cannot assert uniqueness by a single property, so path-uniqueness (no two entries with the same normalized relative_path) and entrypoint-presence (the entrypoint appears in files) remain evaluator/verifier consistency checks, frozen as required R4B implementation-consistency tests. schema_note records that limitation explicitly.

sha256.description: artifact-bytes SHA-256 of a source file (digest domain: artifact_bytes).

relative_path.description: Repository-relative path. No leading slash (absolute rejected), no backslash, single '/' separators only (no empty segments, no '//', no trailing slash), and no '..' path segment (traversal rejected). Uniqueness by normalized relative_path is an evaluator consistency check.
